_readme: Owner-editable seasonality + our own changes. The scorecard prints the notes that apply to a week and never flags a drop that the season explains. expect: high | normal | low (what the owner expects of ORDERING demand that week). Add a row whenever something moves the numbers on purpose.

seasons.note: Pre-season ordering: tournaments and leagues start in September, teams order ahead (August is typically the best month).
Season underway: fewer first orders, more re-orders and late joiners. Lower than August is normal.
Summer tournaments and end-of-season orders for next year.
